title: MIS / Nexis Project
shortDescription: The MIS Inventory Management System streamlines IT asset tracking and management through detailed logs, automated tagging, and integration with Next HRM via LDAP.
longDescription: The MIS Inventory Management System streamlines IT asset tracking and management through detailed logs, automated tagging, and integration with Next HRM via LDAP. It distinguishes between stock and inventory, offering real-time insights and role-based access for efficient hardware lifecycle management. This system simplifies inventory audits, allocations, and repair tracking.
problem: IT assets need a clear history, from allocation to repair.
solution: A role-based inventory platform with automated tagging, detailed logs, and LDAP integration with Next HRM.
outcome: A connected view of stock, inventory, allocations, and the hardware lifecycle.

title: POS Online Ordering
shortDescription: Online Ordering is a product where customers can build their own website and app for your restaurant. It is built in Angular frontend with Admin Panel.

title: GetWorker
shortDescription: GetWorker is a website that is similar to freelancer.com in which one user can post a task and others can apply for this task and the tasker can hire one or more bidders to complete the posted task. This is API based project, the API was built in Laravel 6 and, the application was built in Angular 8 and also made a hybrid app in IONIC (using Angular).

title: Remmi CRM
shortDescription: Remmi CRM is a product that is built for a client. It is a customer relationship and task management software built for a real estate company that helps you improve business performance.
longDescription: Remmi CRM is a product that is built for a client. It is a customer relationship and task management software built for a real estate company that helps you improve business performance. Build valuable relationships with clients and manage properties, projects/apartments, leads, leads management, contacts, staff, developers, and tasks.
problem: A real estate team needs to connect properties, relationships, and daily tasks.
solution: A CRM spanning properties, projects, leads, contacts, staff, and task management.
outcome: A unified application for managing client relationships and property workflows.

title: Group Captain Project
shortDescription: A platform that provides document management, project management, and a Kanban board for tracking project tasks and activities.
longDescription: A platform that provides document management, project management, and a Kanban board for tracking project tasks and activities. It also includes a comprehensive admin panel for managing users, roles, permissions, apps, organizations, talent, and website settings. Admins can manage users, assign roles, and view projects and tasks.
problem: Documents, project work, and organizational access need one shared workspace.
solution: Document and project management, a Kanban board, and an admin panel for organizations, roles, and permissions.
outcome: A workspace for managing project activity and controlling organizational access.

title: XfinityClassified Ad System
shortDescription: XfinityClassified is a classified Ad Web application for code Canyon. A modulable classified app having a fully responsive bootstrap design. It is built in Angular 7 fronted & Laravel 5.7 with Admin Panel. It is developed from scratch to the end.

title: Smart Destination Project
shortDescription: A platform that can help to sell tours and activities for travelers on the island through an e-commerce web page. Travelers can see the accommodation choices on the website, however, to book them the site will direct them to the hotel’s booking page.

title: Research Support Web Tool (RSWT)
shortDescription: Research support web tool (RSWT) is a search engine built in Angular for researchers with web scraping techniques using PHP to extract data from different digital libraries. We use semantic search queries in RSWT. Scraping website includes ACM digital library, science direct, Eric, etc.
